conflicts.issue: Product demands GA by Sept 22 with a minimum shippable scope, while Designer requested full error/recovery and WCAG AA coverage before launch. Resolved by keeping the launch GA-bound, implementing a lightweight WCAG AA checklist and complete core error states now, and deferring deeper accessibility polish to v1.1 if needed.

Product wants fastest time-to-GA, while EngLead required a multi-identity refactor, dependency upgrades, and strict API freezing before implementation. Resolved by front-loading the contract/security work, then parallelizing backend/frontend after the freeze to preserve the Sept 22 GA path.

Product wants GA by Sept 22, while QA requires automation, staging manual QA, regression, and a pre-GA bug bash. Resolved by keeping the release full and adding only the minimum required QA gates to protect GA without expanding scope.

Product requires a GA launch, while Security requires threat modeling, audit-log parity, identity-link protections, and compliance sign-off before production. Resolved by treating security approvals as pre-implementation and pre-GA blockers, with no beta path and full-release only after sign-off.

Product wants GA to coincide with the Sept 22 sales kickoff, while GTM requires support readiness, comms approval, training, and feedback handling. Resolved by bundling GTM prep into the critical path and keeping launch as GA, not beta, with a short post-launch feedback loop.

Designer wanted complete UX states signed off before build, while EngLead needed a frozen auth API contract first to avoid rework. Resolved by making the API freeze the first gate, then designing against that contract in parallel with security review.

Designer required design-QA against approved specs, while QA required staging manual verification and bug bash. Resolved by adding an explicit design-QA sign-off in the staging QA step so both are satisfied without adding extra phases.

EngLead needed to move quickly on the identity refactor, while Security required pre-implementation threat modeling, PII/token review, and ownership-proof controls. Resolved by making security approvals a prerequisite to coding and by limiting the first release to the minimal Google OIDC and account-linking surface.

EngLead wanted implementation plus rollout telemetry from day one, while QA required a reviewed test plan and coverage before build freeze. Resolved by defining instrumentation in the backend/frontend steps and having QA own the test-plan/automation gate before launch.
GTM needs launch-day readiness, while Security requires SOC2 evidence and compliance sign-off before GA. Resolved by making compliance approval an explicit go/no-go input to the launch step.

mvp_fast.issue: Launch strategy says 'full release under feature flags' but the plan doesn't say feature flags are a release gate for GA readiness.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Clarify full GA launch is 100% enabled for eligible SMB users once approvals are complete, with flags only as rollout controls.

mvp_fast.issue: UX flow says error/recovery states are 'minimal' and doesn't name empty, denied-consent, or link-conflict states.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Expand the signed UX spec to include full empty, loading, error, and recovery states for all auth paths.

mvp_fast.issue: Frontend build references approved design, but no explicit WCAG AA accessibility pass is required before implementation or launch.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add accessibility criteria to the build definition and require WCAG AA review of buttons, dialogs, focus order, and messaging.

mvp_fast.issue: Staging QA mentions flow validation, but not a design-QA check that the shipped UI matches the approved auth designs.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a design-QA sign-off checkpoint against the approved sign-in, linking, and provisioning specs before launch.

mvp_fast.issue: API/identity spec is approved by ProductPM and QA too, but no explicit second-engineer review gate before client work
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a mandatory Eng lead second-engineer review/approval on the frozen auth API contract before frontend or backend client work starts

mvp_fast.issue: Step names auth API + identity model, but doesn't explicitly freeze the client contract details (requests, responses, errors, idempotency)
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Expand the spec to enumerate exact API shapes, callback contracts, error codes, and idempotency semantics as a versioned freeze artifact

mvp_fast.issue: Backend auth refactor starts without an explicit dependency upgrade gate for OIDC/JWT libraries being completed first
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Make S2's dependency upgrade plan a hard prerequisite to S4 implementation and record the chosen library versions before coding

mvp_fast.issue: Feature flags are mentioned, but day-one rollout instrumentation is too vague for sign-in/link/provision/failure events
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Define structured event names, payload fields, and flag gates in S4 so rollout telemetry exists from the first deploy

mvp_fast.issue: Frontend work can start before the auth API contract is frozen; that risks rework on OAuth/linking callbacks
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Gate S5 on the signed auth API spec from S1 and prohibit UI implementation until the contract is versioned

mvp_fast.issue: UI instrumentation is only button click/auth start/success-failure; it misses linking and provisioning events needed for feature-flag rollout
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add explicit frontend events for link initiated/completed/failed and auto-provision start/success/failure

mvp_fast.issue: QA/security staging step says audit-log checks, but doesn't verify SOC2 audit logs match password sessions identically
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a staging validation for audit-log parity: same required fields and event semantics for Google SSO and password sessions

mvp_fast.issue: Launch step relies on support/comms, but doesn't include final engineering gate for release-readiness of flags, telemetry, and rollback
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add an engineering go/no-go checklist before GA covering flag defaults, telemetry health, and rollback readiness

mvp_fast.issue: QA automation scope misses the required bug-bash before GA.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a pre-GA stakeholder bug bash step with release-blocker triage and explicit resolution criteria.

mvp_fast.issue: Manual QA on staging is included, but no explicit sign-off artifact or pass/fail gate is defined.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Require a named QA sign-off artifact from staging with confirmed sign-in, linking, and auto-provisioning coverage.

mvp_fast.issue: GA step lacks an explicit quality gate tying launch to green regression and completed QA sign-off.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Gate S8 on reviewed test plan, green regression suite, staging QA sign-off, and completed bug bash.

mvp_fast.issue: Security approval is not explicitly gated before implementation starts.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a prereq that S1 cannot start until the threat-model doc, authz review, and PII/token handling review are approved.

mvp_fast.issue: Threat model is scheduled after S1 starts, but it must be completed before implementation.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Move the threat model to a pre-implementation gate and make S4 depend on its approval.

mvp_fast.issue: Audit-log spec may miss required coverage for account-link/unlink and provisioning outcomes.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Explicitly require audit events for link, unlink, sign-in, provision, failure, and workspace attachment results.

mvp_fast.issue: No explicit PII/sensitive-data handling review for OIDC claims and token storage.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a security review item covering minimal claim retention, refresh/access token storage, encryption, and rotation.

mvp_fast.issue: Multi-identity auth refactor lacks explicit security sign-off before merge.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Require security approval on identity-linking rules, session issuance, and privilege boundaries before implementation is merged.

mvp_fast.issue: Account-linking ownership proof is not called out as a security requirement.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add an explicit control requiring strong proof of account ownership before attaching Google to an existing account.

mvp_fast.issue: Domain auto-provisioning may be spoofable without verified Google-issued identity assertions.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a security acceptance check that provisioning only occurs from verified Google OIDC assertions and cannot be triggered by domain guesswork.

mvp_fast.issue: SOC2 audit-log validation is mentioned, but compliance sign-off is not an explicit launch gate.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Make compliance approval required before GA, with evidence that SSO sessions are logged identically to password sessions.

mvp_fast.issue: Support runbook isn't explicitly approved before launch; GA support can't wait on drafting during launch prep.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a pre-launch gated artifact for a published support runbook covering login, linking, and auto-provisioning failures.

mvp_fast.issue: Support training is bundled into the launch step without a completed session requirement.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Require a recorded pre-launch training session and attendance/acknowledgment from the support team before GA.

mvp_fast.issue: Launch comms plan and sales enablement are mentioned, but no final approved comms package is required before GA.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add an approved launch-day comms plan with timing, audience, channels, and support handoff, plus ready sales FAQ/deck.

mvp_fast.issue: No explicit week-1 feedback channel is scheduled for early SMB Google SSO adopters.
mvp_fast.suggested_change: Add a staffed, monitored feedback channel for the first week after launch with clear triage ownership.

standard.issue: Support readiness is not in the plan beyond docs/training; launch needs a documented runbook before GA and support coverage at launch.
standard.suggested_change: Add a pre-GA support runbook approval step and launch-day support staffing/coverage tied to GA timing.

standard.issue: The plan does not define 'launched' concretely as GA vs beta or the rollout threshold for SMB users.
standard.suggested_change: State launch as full GA for eligible SMB users by Sept 22, with no beta/invite-only phase.

standard.issue: Customer comms timing is not explicitly tied to GA readiness, so announcements could go out before support is ready.
standard.suggested_change: Add a gated comms milestone: publish SMB launch comms no later than GA and only after support materials are approved.

standard.issue: UX step doesn't explicitly require the approved design spec before frontend build starts.
standard.suggested_change: Add a sign-off gate that frontend work waits on the finalized, approved UX spec for all auth states.

standard.issue: The UX scope omits empty/loading/fallback states for recognized-domain provisioning and link conflicts.
standard.suggested_change: Expand the design to cover loading, empty, success, denial, and conflict recovery states for each flow.

standard.issue: Frontend implementation can start before UX sign-off is clearly gated, risking build against incomplete flows.
standard.suggested_change: Make S5 depend on approved UX spec and accessibility review completion before implementation begins.

standard.issue: Staging QA mentions accessibility checks but not a formal design-QA comparison against the approved spec.
standard.suggested_change: Require a design-QA checklist in staging that verifies layout, copy, states, and interactions match the signed design.

standard.issue: No explicit launch gate for WCAG AA pass on the built auth flow.
standard.suggested_change: Add an accessibility sign-off criterion confirming keyboard, focus, contrast, labels, and screen reader support.

standard.issue: Specs don't explicitly freeze client-facing auth API contracts before frontend work starts.
standard.suggested_change: Add a signed auth-api-spec with request/response shapes, errors, and idempotency as a hard gate before S5.

standard.issue: No explicit dependency plan for OIDC/JWT library or platform upgrades needed for Google SSO.
standard.suggested_change: Add a dependency-upgrade plan with versions, migration steps, and rollback before implementation.

standard.issue: Implementation step lacks an explicit second-engineer review gate for auth and identity refactor code.
standard.suggested_change: Require recorded review approval from a second engineer before merging S4.

standard.issue: Feature-flag and structured event instrumentation should be defined from day one, not only after code lands.
standard.suggested_change: Define feature flags and event names for sign-in, link, provision, and failures before coding starts.

standard.issue: Plan doesn't call out technical-debt tradeoffs for the multi-identity refactor and provisioning shortcuts.
standard.suggested_change: Document deferred debt items, why they are deferred, and the follow-up work required before GA.

standard.issue: QA coverage is missing an explicit reviewed test plan approval gate before build freeze.
standard.suggested_change: Add a prerequisite requiring QA lead approval of the test plan before S6 starts.

standard.issue: Automated tests are described, but not explicitly covering duplicate identity, existing free-account upgrade, and unrecognized domain edge cases.
standard.suggested_change: Expand S6 to name these edge cases in the automated suite and acceptance criteria.

standard.issue: Manual QA staging sign-off is included, but the plan does not require a pre-launch bug bash with stakeholders.
standard.suggested_change: Add a dedicated pre-GA bug bash step with stakeholder participation and release-blocker closure.

standard.issue: No explicit regression-suite gate ties launch readiness to legacy email/password auth staying green.
standard.suggested_change: Add a launch-blocking QA constraint that the full regression suite passes with no password-auth regressions.

standard.issue: Security sign-off is listed, but no explicit authz review of multi-identity session boundaries and privilege escalation paths.
standard.suggested_change: Add a security review checkpoint covering authz rules for linked identities, session issuance, and cross-identity privilege boundaries.

standard.issue: Implementation can proceed after S2, but the plan does not show the required second-engineer security review for auth/identity changes.
standard.suggested_change: Add a recorded second-engineer review gate before merging backend auth, identity, and provisioning code.

standard.issue: PII/token handling is not clearly enforced in the backend build step; the plan only mentions it in security review, not implementation controls.
standard.suggested_change: Specify minimal claims retention, encrypted storage for tokens if any, and explicit no-persist rules for unnecessary Google profile data.

standard.issue: Audit logging is mentioned, but the backend step lacks concrete coverage for unlink, linking failure, and provisioning-attack attempts.
standard.suggested_change: Expand structured events to include link/unlink, denied link attempts, provisioning rejects, and other security-relevant outcomes.

standard.issue: Manual QA covers flows, but there is no explicit security test for account-link misuse cases like re-linking an already-owned Google identity.
standard.suggested_change: Add negative security scenarios to staging QA for duplicate identity attach, takeover attempts, and ownership-confirmation failures.

standard.issue: Support documentation may expose sensitive recovery details unless the runbook is reviewed for safe handling of auth data and account-link proofs.
standard.suggested_change: Include security review of support materials to ensure no sensitive tokens, claims, or recovery shortcuts are documented.

standard.issue: Support docs are not explicitly complete before launch; the step is truncated and lacks a clear runbook deliverable.
standard.suggested_change: Add a concrete support runbook deliverable and completion gate for SSO, linking, provisioning, and escalation paths.

standard.issue: No explicit support-team training session is scheduled or required before GA.
standard.suggested_change: Add a pre-launch support training session with attendance/recording as a launch gate.

standard.issue: Launch-day customer/internal comms plan is not defined in the support-owned launch prep.
standard.suggested_change: Include a launch-day comms plan covering audience, channels, timing, and ownership before GA.

standard.issue: Week-1 feedback channel for early SMB users is not called out.
standard.suggested_change: Add a monitored feedback channel for the first week after launch and define who staffs it.

robust_launch.issue: S1 confirms Sept 22 GA target but doesn't define GA exit criteria or rollout threshold.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add explicit launch criteria: GA means 100% SMB availability, launch comms live, and support runbook/training complete.

robust_launch.issue: S1 says scope is locked, but doesn't codify the SMB cutoff or launch status for users.
robust_launch.suggested_change: State the exact eligible population (free+paid up to 50 seats) and that launch is GA, not beta or invite-only.

robust_launch.issue: Plan omits a concrete launch definition tied to the success metric window after release.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a post-launch review milestone for 30-day adoption and free→paid conversion measurement.

robust_launch.issue: No customer comms timing is anchored to a required pre-GA deadline.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Require launch comms to be approved and scheduled before GA, with customer-facing messaging live on launch day.

robust_launch.issue: UX flow spec is not explicitly signed off before build starts; launch depends on approved design artifacts.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a design-spec sign-off gate with named reviewer and require approval before S4/S6 implementation begins.

robust_launch.issue: The plan says WCAG AA, but does not specify keyboard/focus, contrast, labels, and screen-reader checks as launch gates.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add an accessibility checklist and acceptance gate for keyboard nav, focus order, contrast, form labels, and SR support.

robust_launch.issue: Error, empty, and recovery states are mentioned, but the plan does not enumerate link conflicts, denied consent, or unrecognized domain UX.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Expand the design spec to include explicit empty/error/recovery states for consent denial, link conflicts, and domain lookup failures.

robust_launch.issue: No design-QA review gate is defined for the implemented SMB Google SSO experience before launch.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a pre-launch UX QA review step against the approved design for sign-in, linking, provisioning, and failure states.

robust_launch.issue: Implementation can proceed before the design spec is approved, which risks rework and mismatched shipped UI.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Make S3 approval a hard dependency for S6 and any frontend work.

robust_launch.issue: QA plan isn't explicitly a reviewed artifact before build freeze, though that's launch-gating for quality.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a hard dependency on approval:QA lead and require the reviewed test plan before build freeze starts.

robust_launch.issue: Manual QA is mentioned, but the plan doesn't require a staging build to exist before QA starts.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add wait_for:staging build as a prerequisite for the manual QA pass step or checklist.

robust_launch.issue: There's no explicit bug-bash milestone with stakeholders before GA, which is required for pre-launch verification.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a pre-GA bug bash step with stakeholders and make release-blocking defects a gate to GA.

robust_launch.issue: QA automation/regression green isn't tied to code merge criteria, so build may complete without test evidence.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Make S6 completion depend on passing automated happy-path, edge-case, and legacy regression suites.

robust_launch.issue: Day-one instrumentation is included, but the plan doesn't require audit-log verification for SSO parity before GA.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add explicit verification that SSO sessions are recorded identically to password sessions in audit logs.

robust_launch.issue: Threat model is scheduled after scoping but doesn't require pre-implementation signoff on auth bypass, link hijack, or token theft artifacts.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Make S2 a hard gate before any code starts and require approved threat-model doc plus explicit attack-path mitigations.

robust_launch.issue: PII and OAuth token handling is mentioned, but there is no explicit security approval gate for claims minimization, encryption, or retention.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a required security review/approval for OIDC claims, token storage, rotation, and retention before implementation.

robust_launch.issue: Audit logging is defined, but the plan doesn't force a reviewed audit-log spec before implementation of SSO/link/provision actions.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add wait_for:audit-log-spec as a blocker with events for sign-in, link/unlink, provisioning, and failures.

robust_launch.issue: Domain auto-provisioning security is only described generically; it needs an explicit abuse review for spoofed Google Workspace domains.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a required domain-claim abuse review covering verified Google-issued identity assertions and spoofing resistance.

robust_launch.issue: The auth refactor lacks an explicit security review gate for multi-identity session issuance and privilege boundaries.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Require security signoff on the identity-linking rules before S4 implementation begins.

robust_launch.issue: Second-engineer review is noted, but there is no explicit security review step for the linking/issuance code path before merge.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add review:security as a blocker for auth middleware, account linking, and workspace provisioning changes.

robust_launch.issue: Implemented auth actions are only said to emit structured events; the plan doesn't ensure every SSO/link/provision event is written to the audited log.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Make audited log writes mandatory for sign-in, link/unlink, provisioning, and failure events, and verify in integration tests.

robust_launch.issue: No explicit control prevents linking a Google identity to the wrong existing account or one already owned elsewhere.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add ownership proof checks and duplicate-identity conflict handling as required acceptance criteria for account linking.

robust_launch.issue: Domain-based provisioning implementation doesn't state how spoofing is prevented using Google-issued assertions only.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Constrain provisioning to verified OIDC claims and reject any domain-recognition path without authenticated Google assertions.

robust_launch.issue: SOC2/compliance sign-off lead time is not modeled as a gated dependency before GA.
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add an explicit compliance approval milestone and reserve lead time before the Sept 22 GA cutover.

robust_launch.issue: No support runbook or launch-day support comms are gated before GA
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a blocking support readiness checkpoint requiring the runbook and launch comms plan before launch approval.

robust_launch.issue: No support team training is scheduled before the Sept 22 GA
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a pre-launch training milestone and require support attendance/sign-off before launch.

robust_launch.issue: No week-1 feedback channel owner or setup is called out
robust_launch.suggested_change: Add a post-launch support feedback channel with monitoring ownership for the first week.

robust_launch.issue: Sales enablement for SMB paid motion is not gated for launch readiness
robust_launch.suggested_change: Require a sales FAQ/deck for Google SSO before GA if this is part of the paid SMB motion.
